swap_policy: Record existing swap; reject paging-dependent runs from resident-memory rankings
model_filesystem: WSL ext4 VHDX stored on SN7100; not /mnt/c
driver_policy: Windows NVIDIA driver only; do not install Linux display/kernel driver in WSL
comparison_note: Default WSL cap can be lower than installed RAM. Also record Windows host usage. Keep native 46GiB matched-memory lane separate from native 52GiB best-achievable lane.
